title: Cartwise Shopper Batches Tip Share and Pay Finality Schedule
content:
On Cartwise Shopper Batches the share of each customer tip paid to the shopper, the hours after completion at which a batch's pay and tips become final, the weekly earnings cut-off and the visibility of the pay breakdown are set per batch type.

| Batch type | Share of the customer's tip paid to the shopper | Pay and tips final after (hours from completion) | Weekly earnings period ends | Shopper sees each pay component in the app |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Shop-Only Batch | 100 percent | 24 | Sunday 23:59 local time | Yes |
| Express 30 Batch | 100 percent | 24 | Sunday 23:59 local time | Yes |
| Single Delivery Batch | 100 percent | 24 | Sunday 23:59 local time | Yes |
| Double Delivery Batch | 100 percent | 24 | Sunday 23:59 local time | Yes |
| Triple Delivery Batch | 100 percent | 24 | Sunday 23:59 local time | Yes |
| Stock-Up Batch | 100 percent | 48 | Sunday 23:59 local time | Yes |

## Points of the schedule

- Every batch type passes 100 percent of the customer's tip to the shopper.
- Pay and tips become final 24 hours after completion on every batch type except the Stock-Up Batch, whose pay becomes final after 48 hours.
- The weekly earnings period used by weekly payouts ends at Sunday 23:59 local time for every batch type.

## Hypothetical illustration

A hypothetical Stock-Up Batch completed on a Tuesday at 18:00 has its pay and tips become final 48 hours later, on the Thursday at 18:00; a Double Delivery Batch completed at the same moment becomes final on the Wednesday at 18:00.
